# jl-react-virtual-signature-canvas

> High-performance, lightweight, and responsive electronic signature component for React (React Signature Pad / Canvas). Touch-friendly with curve stabilization and auto-cropping.

## Package Summary
- **npm package**: `jl-react-virtual-signature-canvas`
- **npm URL**: https://www.npmjs.com/package/jl-react-virtual-signature-canvas
- **Repository**: https://github.com/cjorgeluis122333/jl-react-virtual-signature-canvas
- **Live Documentation & Demo**: https://jl-react-virtual-signature-canvas.vercel.app/
- **Interactive Playground**: https://jl-react-virtual-signature-canvas.vercel.app/?mode=playground
- **License**: MIT
- **Languages Supported**: English, Spanish (ES / EN)

## Key Features
- **Touch & Mouse Support**: Seamless native event handling (`touchstart`, `touchmove`, `mousedown`).
- **Stroke Stabilization**: Built-in algorithm to smooth curve drawing for realistic digital signatures.
- **Auto-Cropping**: Trims empty margins automatically on `toDataURL('image/png')`.
- **History Control**: Imperative methods (`clear()`, `undo()`, `isEmpty()`) accessible via React `ref`.
- **TypeScript First**: Full typing for props (`SignatureCanvasProps`) and refs (`SignatureCanvasRef`).
- **Zero Heavy Dependencies**: Native canvas rendering for maximum rendering speed and tiny bundle size.

## Quick Start Code Snippet

```tsx
import React, { useRef } from 'react';
import { SignatureCanvas, SignatureCanvasRef } from 'jl-react-virtual-signature-canvas';

export default function App() {
  const signatureRef = useRef<SignatureCanvasRef>(null);

  const handleSave = () => {
    if (signatureRef.current?.isEmpty()) {
      console.log('Signature is empty');
      return;
    }
    // Exports auto-cropped Base64 PNG image
    const dataUrl = signatureRef.current?.toDataURL('image/png');
    console.log('Signature Data URL:', dataUrl);
  };

  const handleClear = () => {
    signatureRef.current?.clear();
  };

  const handleUndo = () => {
    signatureRef.current?.undo();
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <SignatureCanvas
        ref={signatureRef}
        width="100%"
        height={220}
        strokeColor="#0f172a"
        strokeWidth={3}
        stabilization={true}
        autoCrop={true}
      />
      <div>
        <button onClick={handleUndo}>Undo</button>
        <button onClick={handleClear}>Clear</button>
        <button onClick={handleSave}>Save</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
